import sys


def main():
    s = sys.stdin.buffer.read()
    letters = b"abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    cnt = [s.count(bytes([c])) for c in letters]
    del s
    # First half in non-decreasing order; the single odd-count letter (if any) goes in the center.
    half = b"".join(bytes([c]) * (k // 2) for c, k in zip(letters, cnt))
    center = b"".join(bytes([c]) for c, k in zip(letters, cnt) if k % 2)
    out = sys.stdout.buffer
    out.write(half)
    out.write(center)
    out.write(half[::-1])
    out.write(b"\n")


main()
